limitation: Saved server implementations are unavailable. UI actions, rule code and release notes do not prove server outcomes, optimizer optimality or complete native automation coverage.

decisions.native: Paid Auto Jobs supports selected Job, mastery, XP or cash goals and a proportional energy reserve; ordinary Job execution is also exposed.
decisions.hub_role: Delegate only when owned and the goal/reserve contract matches; otherwise schedule ordinary available Jobs.
decisions.gates: An owned pass is not an active controller. Cross-feature priorities, absolute reserves and Contract goals still need hub coordination.

decisions.native: Native Operation start and current reward/cost metadata.
decisions.hub_role: Keep a compact goal, eligible-slot selection and spending policy.
decisions.gates: No equivalent goal-driven auto-start controller found in the reviewed Ops UI. Instant completion is a separate paid/voucher action, not a replacement.

decisions.hub_role: Collect only ready matching runs and verify each result.
decisions.gates: Elapsed time alone is not proof; no blanket instant-complete or cancel.

decisions.hub_role: Choose eligible runs under the shared energy/stake policy.
decisions.gates: Native action handles the game operation; the hub still owns selection, board freshness and uncertainty.

decisions.hub_role: Keep separate collection permission and exact run/reward reconciliation.
decisions.gates: Do not infer collection from an empty panel or elapsed timer.

decisions.native: Native help action and current board.
decisions.hub_role: Apply relationship exclusions, daily cap and energy reserve.
decisions.gates: No equivalent automatic helper found in the reviewed UI; preserve independent permission.

decisions.hub_role: Retain explicit opt-in, exclusions, usage limits and result confirmation.
decisions.gates: This does not authorize district sabotage, leadership actions or new live social actions.

decisions.native: Native hit list, player attack and target UI.
decisions.hub_role: Keep one simple eligibility/evidence/ranking pipeline and native outcome observation.
decisions.gates: No equivalent autonomous player-target selector found; player consent, shields, health, identity and day limits remain.

decisions.native: Native fight and war context surfaces.
decisions.hub_role: Use the common fight planner with verified active-war identity.
decisions.gates: War roster and player hit-list identities are distinct. Native city Boss Auto is not a PvP or war controller.

decisions.native: Paid city Boss Auto exists, with stage progression and selectable consumable refills; ordinary city Boss attacks also exist.
decisions.hub_role: Prefer observing an owned active run; use hub-managed ordinary eligible fights when native scope cannot honor the chosen policy.
decisions.gates: Validate health/reserve/cap/refill compatibility before delegation. Ownership is separate from bossStage.auto; do not apply city Boss ownership to Global Boss or Takedown.

decisions.hub_role: Choose item, quantity, token reserve and per-run cap.
decisions.gates: Native purchase is sufficient as an operation, not as a budget-aware shopping policy.

decisions.native: Native Auto Equip covers player and available Crew; release notes explicitly add two- and three-piece set bonuses.
decisions.hub_role: Use this as the default gear engine, triggered by relevant changes with no-op suppression and state proof.
decisions.gates: No client pass gate is visible in the handler. Server optimization, collection effects and user exclusions are not inspectable here; validate custody before enabling.

decisions.native: Native Auto Equip already claims set-aware strongest gear. No evidence establishes that the old custom optimizer beats it.
decisions.hub_role: Retain optional constrained gear goals and comparison work; defer a second automatic optimizer until a concrete gap is demonstrated.
decisions.gates: One loadout owner only. Multi-step swaps and Collection withdrawals require separate scope, exact proof and recovery; never silently override native results.

decisions.native: Paid Auto Roll can target empty slots or every slot below chosen rarity; ordinary hire/dismiss UI also exists.
decisions.hub_role: Delegate only for an owned, compatible run; preserve an independent funded normal hire/replacement policy where ordinary actions are available.
decisions.gates: Do not invoke paid rolling without ownership or imitate its ownership state. Trained/protected/stationed members and cash limits may make native broad scope unsuitable.

decisions.native: Native Crew sort orders strongest first and reports pinned stationed/auto-rolling slots.
decisions.hub_role: Use the native sort; schedule after meaningful roster changes.
decisions.gates: Stable member identities must survive index changes; confirm final positions. Do not build a second sorting transaction.

decisions.hub_role: Select the exact injured member under a stamina reserve.
decisions.gates: Separate from item healing; recheck injury and recall state. Native healing is not an automatic recovery policy.

decisions.hub_role: Choose target level/cost and reserve available home Crew.
decisions.gates: Use current costs/timers; no duplicate training request or trained-member dismissal.

decisions.hub_role: Keep bounded Contract-owned empty-slot hiring.
decisions.gates: A contract goal does not authorize dismissal, unlimited rolling or paid chance bonuses.

decisions.hub_role: Select permitted stacks and exact injury; use independent native Crew cooldown/sequence.
decisions.gates: Tradable use stays separate and bound-first; do not replace with player item-use or stamina healing.

decisions.native: Native background and border equip actions.
decisions.hub_role: Keep purposeful cosmetic comparison unless native Auto Equip is proven to cover cosmetics and the requested objective.
decisions.gates: Gear Auto Equip does not establish cosmetic coverage. Collection display/custody and protected copies still need checks.

decisions.native: Native exact-amount transfers plus Deposit All and Withdraw All.
decisions.hub_role: Use exact safe-surplus amounts after gear/Market reservations and checkpoint protection.
decisions.gates: Do not replace surplus policy with Deposit All: the client gives no selected exclusion/reserve payload. Withdraw All explicitly removes Collection bonuses.

decisions.native: Native quantity-based crate opening and current luck helper.
decisions.hub_role: Use supported batches for selected owned unbound chests under the chosen luck/cap policy.
decisions.gates: No automatic purchases, bound opening or duplicated one-by-one loop when a validated batch is sufficient.

decisions.native: Native consumable use and resource state.
decisions.hub_role: Keep a compact resource/size/threshold policy using current native cooldowns.
decisions.gates: Do not conflate city Boss Auto refill choices with permission to consume for unrelated work.

decisions.hub_role: Keep cash-to-keep, purchase saving and purpose reservations.
decisions.gates: No equivalent cross-feature banking planner found; no-fee pass benefits remain server entitlements.

decisions.hub_role: Fund exact authorized shortfalls, confirm transfer, then replan purchase.
decisions.gates: Never replace this with periodic full-bank withdrawal.

decisions.hub_role: Keep one deterministic property-goal planner with spend/cash/selection limits.
decisions.gates: Native Shop Auto Buy is not Property Auto Buy; income pass multipliers cannot be supplied by client automation. Replacement stays separate.

decisions.hub_role: Check eligibility/budget and invoke the native upgrade operation.
decisions.gates: No need to recreate upgrade application; do retain tier and spend limits and outcome proof.

decisions.hub_role: Expose clear eligibility/reset limits and keep an explicit switch.
decisions.gates: Do not replace a guarded reset policy with automatic UI confirmation.

decisions.native: Paid Auto Buy already has item kinds, minimum rarity, only-new, currency, Gold reserve and out-of-funds behavior; ordinary Shop buys exist.
decisions.hub_role: Offer owned-native delegation only when those rules meet the requested scope; otherwise plan ordinary permitted native purchases.
decisions.gates: Gold reserve is not a cash reserve or total spend cap. Do not start broad native purchasing while claiming hub limits can constrain it.

decisions.native: Native listing browse and price surfaces.
decisions.hub_role: Reuse native quotes/RAP rather than reconstruct price feeds; keep freshness and useful demand summaries.
decisions.gates: No equivalent automatic opportunity/research policy found; read results are not sales.

decisions.hub_role: Keep protected-copy selection, price/net-fee policy and per-listing proof.
decisions.gates: Native listing UI is not safe-surplus automation; no destructive sales or bot-check bypass.

decisions.hub_role: Keep bounded buy-to-list planning, item/price identity, Gold budget and durable uncertainty.
decisions.gates: No equivalent autonomous profit policy found; never buy/list merely because the native operation exists.

decisions.native: Native timed Market rental using owned Gold, alongside the permanent Shop pass.
decisions.hub_role: Prefer the ordinary rental option when desired and affordable, without requiring a pass purchase.
decisions.gates: This costs in-game Gold and is not free or equivalent to permanent pass ownership; use current quote, reserve and attempted-rent cap.

decisions.hub_role: Collect eligible earnings and maintain a confirmed transaction ledger.
decisions.gates: Collection is not confirmation of every historical sale; aging-listing reports do not authorize cancellation/repricing.

decisions.hub_role: Keep independent amount/reserve/session cap and contribution proof.
decisions.gates: No new shared spending or leadership permission follows from native availability.

decisions.hub_role: Choose permitted perk/condition/amount using current cap/cost facts.
decisions.gates: Preserve separate consent and available-Crew/combat resource coordination.

decisions.hub_role: Keep separate default-off/default-zero cap and exact contribution outcome.
decisions.gates: Do not borrow Auto Buy Gold permissions or spend bound/tradable stacks interchangeably.

decisions.hub_role: Keep free-charge eligibility, health/stamina/cap and weekly/stage checks.
decisions.gates: Paid city Boss Auto does not cover this. Tickets and team effects need separate scope.

decisions.hub_role: Claim only ready matching rewards and reconcile replicated state.
decisions.gates: No equivalent automatic settlement established for Family Takedown by the Global Boss release note.

decisions.hub_role: Reuse native context and add concise read-only advice.
decisions.gates: Native read-only information is enough for facts; no separate simulator or new attack/leadership permissions.

decisions.native: Native individual station, Station All and recall UI.
decisions.hub_role: Use stable member selection to retain home defense, training and recovery limits.
decisions.gates: Station All is not an equivalent to a policy that must retain some Crew at home.

decisions.native: Native residency request/view and admission rules.
decisions.hub_role: Keep own-residence bonus/rent/allowlist selection and exact acceptance/status proof.
decisions.gates: A residency request is not immediate admission; no automatic acceptance of other residents or Family policy changes.

decisions.native: Native daily/weekly earned-entry claim actions and progress UI.
decisions.hub_role: Keep exact entry eligibility and separate claim policy.
decisions.gates: Readiness and native claim operation can be reused; no equivalent permitted-objective executor established.

decisions.hub_role: Claim after exact prerequisite completion; identify refills and awarded crates.
decisions.gates: Claim permission does not authorize opening crates or spending in the Contracts shop.

decisions.hub_role: Keep readiness/ownership checks and supported ordinary claims.
decisions.gates: Exclude set trade-ins that consume items; the common native Trophy page is not permission to consume a set.

decisions.native: Native bulk skill allocation; the UI submits chunks of up to 100.
decisions.hub_role: Use validated native batches for a selected stat and allocation limit.
decisions.gates: Do not rebuild a one-point request loop or infer that the visible batch limit is a universal server contract.

decisions.native: Native earned ladder claims and reward-resolution helpers.
decisions.hub_role: Claim eligible rungs with separate refill preference and current reward metadata.
decisions.gates: No fake elapsed time, synthetic progress or assumed auto-claim.

decisions.hub_role: Check existing membership/eligibility and claim once confirmed.
decisions.gates: No group auto-join or invented claim entitlement.

decisions.native: Native monthly claim and calendar state.
decisions.hub_role: Use native UTC/month identity and earned eligibility.
decisions.gates: A visible calendar is not proof that the server accepted a claim.

decisions.native: Native Contract progress, claims and objective presentation.
decisions.hub_role: Retain a small goal coordinator that requests work from the same permitted domain planners.
decisions.gates: No automatic Contract executor found in the reviewed claim/shop surface; do not duplicate Jobs/Crew/etc. senders.

decisions.native: Native Trophy ownership/claim and item data.
decisions.hub_role: Retain supported goal advice and intent through common permitted planners.
decisions.gates: No proof of a native autonomous Trophy goal executor; unsupported/consuming routes remain manual.

decisions.native: Native Global Boss board and individual attack.
decisions.hub_role: Keep event/run identity, eligibility, health buffer, stamina and sent-attempt cap.
decisions.gates: City Boss Auto access does not establish a Global Boss automation entitlement or controller.

decisions.native: Release notes say unclaimed rewards settle at the next Boss start or event close; a manual claim still exists.
decisions.hub_role: Observe native settlement first; keep an optional explicit early-claim action for eligible settled runs.
decisions.gates: Do not race native settlement or retry a reward already claimed; manual claim and automatic settlement need matching-run state proof.

decisions.hub_role: Choose an eligible unopened case; preserve separate free pick/owned-key limits.
decisions.gates: No prize prediction, key purchase or free extra-pick entitlement.

decisions.hub_role: Use current medal price/origin/account restrictions and a separate budget.
decisions.gates: No bypass of paid-origin, bound-currency or account eligibility rules.

supporting_systems.native: AFKSessionRefreshClient starts a refresh after the 1080-second idle threshold with a five-second stay countdown and teleport/retry flow.
supporting_systems.hub_role: Observe the game-owned flow, checkpoint unresolved work and revalidate on return. Defer an independent anti-idle sender unless a demonstrated gap needs an opt-in fallback.
supporting_systems.gates: A native session refresh does not prove the hub/loader survives or restarts across teleport. Do not force a refresh, suppress the stay choice, or fake input during this audit.

supporting_systems.native: Current shared rules and replicated derived state already describe economics, cooldowns, buffs, sets and eligibility.
supporting_systems.hub_role: Use validated contexts for planners; avoid parallel approximations and stale constants.
supporting_systems.gates: Client code is evidence, not an authoritative server result. Recheck build, shape and freshness.

supporting_systems.hub_role: Keep bounded freshness, demand policy and a confirmed ledger rather than a second price-feed implementation.
supporting_systems.gates: No invented RAP or sale outcome from a quote.

supporting_systems.native: The game has its own preferences; these do not represent this hub configuration or release schema.
supporting_systems.hub_role: Keep typed settings, explicit import/activation, active-profile syncing and redacted diagnostics.
supporting_systems.gates: Do not overwrite native preferences to mimic hub profile ownership.

supporting_systems.native: Native actions and owned controllers operate outside the hub sender.
supporting_systems.hub_role: Retain one hub request, 1s minimum send interval, 0.25s planner checks and exact 45s unconfirmed skip/cooldown. Attribute external changes separately.
supporting_systems.gates: Delegating a long-running native controller cannot honestly promise all its subsequent sends are capped by the hub broker or its budgets.

supporting_systems.hub_role: Retain only useful per-account evidence freshness, saved target goals and reconciled history missing from native UI.
supporting_systems.gates: No duplicate attack attribution, invented win certainty or unnecessary recreation of native presentation.

gearScope.anchor: You and your available henchmen equipped your best available gear.

globalSettle.anchor: Global Boss rewards you have not claimed are auto claimed

serverMissing.anchor: Server Scripts are IMPOSSIBLE to save
